TinadecCore.Api.Tests.WorkspaceSkillPolicyTests.FrontmatterIsAcceptedOnlyWhenItStatesBothFieldsTheWayTheFormatSpellsThem(name: "probe", description: "Long description.", expected: True, expectedReasonStart: null)
A misspelled status is refused instead of answering with an empty queue
An id filter that is not an id says which field broke rather than returning nothing
A page size that is not a count is refused instead of silently unbounded
Promoting a candidate opens an active memory that keeps its constraint
A candidate stored without the optional body reads it back as no key at all
